explanation: Push integer operands onto a stack. Each operator consumes the right operand first, then the left operand, and pushes their result. BigInt division truncates toward zero and exact intermediate arithmetic prevents rounding.
timeComplexity: O(n) parsing/stack operations for expression length n, plus BigInt arithmetic costs.
spaceComplexity: O(n) stack entries, with space for each intermediate BigInt value.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
